policies.cancellationPolicy:
Cancellation & No-Show Policy

Your appointments are reserved especially for you. To respect our time and the time of other clients, please review our policies below:

Cancellations Within 24 Hours

Any appointment canceled within 24 hours of your scheduled time will incur a 50% cancellation fee of the service booked.

No-Shows

If you miss your appointment without any notice, a 100% no-show fee of the service booked will be charged.

How to Cancel or Reschedule

Please cancel or reschedule through our booking system or by contacting us directly as soon as possible. Early notice allows us to offer that time to another client.

services.name: Brazilian
services.description: Experience silky-smooth confidence with our Brazilian wax. We remove all unwanted hair from the front, back, and everything in between, leaving you completely smooth and fresh. Perfect for a clean, flawless feel.

services.description: Keep things neat and tidy with our bikini wax. We gently remove hair along the sides and top of the bikini line, leaving you smooth, fresh, and beach-ready while maintaining a natural look.

services.name: French Bikini
services.description: Get a sleek, smooth look with our French bikini wax, perfect for those who want a little more than a classic bikini wax but not as much as a full Brazilian. This service removes hair from the sides and top of the bikini line, as well as a bit more from the front, leaving a narrow strip or triangle — your choice of style. It’s ideal if you want a cleaner, more defined shape while still leaving some hair for a natural look. Includes backside.

services.name: Jet Plasma Facial
services.description: Transform your face with our Jet Plasma facial. This advanced, non-invasive treatment uses cutting-edge plasma technology to stimulate collagen, tighten skin, and improve overall texture. It helps reduce fine lines, wrinkles, acne, scars, hyperpigmentation, eczema and rosacea, leaving your complexion smoother, brighter, and rejuvenated with no downtime, no numbing required and no discomfort.

services.name: Biorepeel
services.description: Experience the next generation of chemical peels with BioRePeel, a cutting-edge treatment that rejuvenates your skin without the downtime. This Italian-made, medical-grade peel uses a unique blend of vitamins, amino acids, and bio-stimulating ingredients to resurface, hydrate, and restore your skin. Smooths fine lines & wrinkles. Fades acne scars & pigmentation. Minimizes pores & improves texture. Stimulates collagen production. Delivers instant radiance with little to no peeling. Perfect for face, neck, hands, and body, BioRePeel is safe, effective, and suitable for all skin types.

services.name: Jet Plasma Body Treatment
services.description: Revitalize your skin with our Jet Plasma body treatment. This advanced, non-invasive therapy uses plasma technology to stimulate collagen, tighten loose skin, and improve texture on areas like the arms, stomach, thighs, and more. It helps reduce scarring, stretch marks, and uneven tone, leaving your skin firmer, smoother, and beautifully refreshed.

services.name: Vajacial
services.description: A soothing treatment designed for the bikini area to cleanse, gently exfoliate, and calm the skin. Helps reduce ingrowns, brighten, and leave skin soft, smooth, and refreshed. Can be combined with a wax for the ultimate treatment.

services.name: Jet Plasma Eye Treatment
services.description: Revitalize your eyes with our Jet Plasma Eye Treatment, reducing puffiness and revitalizing the delicate skin around your eyes for a youthful glow.

services.name: Clear and Calm add-on
services.description: This elevated add-on combines warm steam and targeted extra extractions to soften the skin, open the pores and gently release trapped hair and congestion after your Brazilian. Service is completed by a hyaluronic acid sheet mask to provide needed moisture. The result is fewer ingrowns, reduced irritation, a smoother finish, and skin that heals faster.
